sonnet.problem: The drawer line starts with 'Meanwhile', which puts Papa Dorin alongside Moses making the tent in the wilderness. It also has nothing to do with the tent, so a stranger would say 'huh?'. The drawer joke is not set up in the line itself either. 'Still standing at Gibeon' also adds a claim the text does not make.
sonnet.rule: He never says he was there, saw it or knew anyone in it. His story is only the Millers' kitchen, the junk drawer and the Dorinverse. / If a stranger would say "huh?", rewrite it. / Don't stretch the text.

sonnet.problem: Cards 14 and 15 both ask about the same point in verse 12, that God will also give Solomon riches, wealth and honor beyond any other king. The question on card 15 re-asks what card 14 already tested.
sonnet.rule: Two lines that make the same point get one question. An answer shown on one card, right or wrong, isn't used again on a later card.
